text: 据北交所网站披露，因固力发集团股份有限公司撤回向不特定合格投资者公开发行股票并在北京证券交易所上市申请文件，北交所决定终止其首次公开发行股票并在北交所上市的审核。
text_en: According to disclosure on the Beijing Stock Exchange website, because Gulifeng Group Co., Ltd. withdrew its application documents for public issuance of shares to unspecified qualified investors and listing on the Beijing Stock Exchange, the BSE decided to terminate the review of its initial public offering and listing on the BSE.
